question: What software was used in campaign 'C0006: Operation Honeybee'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
Found ATT&CK record C0006: Operation Honeybee. C0006 (Operation Honeybee): Operation Honeybee was a campaign that targeted humanitarian aid and inter-Korean affairs organizations from at least late 2017 through early 2018. Operation Honeybee initially targeted South Korea, but expanded to include Vietnam, Singapore, Japan, Indonesia, Argentina, and Canada. Security researchers assessed the threat actors were likely Korean speakers based on metadata used in both lure documents and executables, and named the campaign "Honeybee" after the author name discovered in malicious Word documents.(Citation: McAfee Honeybee). C0006 (Operation Honeybee) has revoked: False; stix_type: campaign; x_mitre_deprecated: False; x_mitre_version: 1.1.
